description: Gain Minor Slayer, increasing damage done to monsters by 5%.

Your Light and Heavy attacks apply a stack of harmful winds to your target for 5 seconds, reduced to 1 second against players. Harmful winds deal 51 Physical Damage per stack every 1 second. This effect can stack once every 0.5 seconds, up to 10 times, and scales off the higher of your Weapon or Spell Damage.
